column1: # Rows db.ptr.tbn.* (line RG, D3c-3b): tblastn -in_pssm of some of psiblast.ptr.tsv's inputs (the same reader) against tests/db_search/tslice (-evalue 1000, outfmt 7; the query rows and descr_elem_null also outfmt 0): NCBI's errors of a value of another class and of a NULL Seq-descr element (its engine error), the NULL elements that its object manager drops or does not read, and LOSAT's refusals of those it reads.
